subject: science
grouping_policy: Rule: independent subquestions (問) are separate requests; 問 sharing conditions, passages, experiments or figures stay together; the sub-items (1, 2, ...) inside one 問 are never split. Pages used whole when only one unit is on them. Groups defined from the problem pages only, without answer-key content.
answer_format: Mark sheet. Most items: choose one katakana choice (ア-ウ ... ア-ケ) per 問; combination tables for multi-blank items (大問1 問6, 大問2 問3, 大問3 問2, 大問4 問4/問8, 大問5 問4). Some items ask for one choice per blank or per case 'それぞれ選べ' with reusable choices: 大問1 問4 (①② from ア-ウ), 大問2 問1 (①-③ from ア-ケ), 大問2 問5 (two periods from ア-エ), 大問4 問7 (solutions 1-3 from ア-ウ). Numeric answers use digit boxes labeled in katakana: 'アイ g' (大問1 問7). Cover instructions 9-11 explain digit boxes, rounding and one choice per answer field.
